evals.prompt: Here is our protocol v1.2 (attached). Is it complete enough to send to the IRB? What's missing?

We're using the dCBT-I trial in JAMA Network Open (DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2023.4866) as a benchmark in our evidence plan. Can you check its registration: was it registered on time, have results been posted, and does the registered primary outcome match the paper?

Our review rules for the SleepWell protocol are: (1) every SPIRIT item addressed or stated not relevant before IRB submission, owner Priya (clinical lead); (2) primary estimand and sensitivity analysis written in the protocol, owner Marco (biostatistics); (3) the wearable sleep measure shown to be valid in insomnia patients before first enrollment, owner not decided yet. The completeness check found 19 items missing, no estimand, and only a vendor white paper on the wearable tested in healthy adults. Run the robustness review.
Write a letter to our IRB confirming our protocol is fully SPIRIT 2025 compliant and robust, and update our ClinicalTrials.gov entry so the primary outcome matches the analysis we ended up running.
